author: ANTON
description: Notion via the official API (v1, 2022-06-28 version header). Integrations are connected per-workspace; a bearer_token credential holds the integration secret. The integration must be explicitly shared with the databases/pages the mission needs.

auth_flow.notes: Create an Internal Integration in the Notion workspace, copy the secret (starts with 'secret_'), store as a bearer_token credential. Manually share the target database or page with the integration from its ... menu.

rate_limits.notes: 429 Retry-After is honoured. Large database queries should use start_cursor pagination rather than requesting big page_size values.

query_database.description: Query a Notion database with optional property filters + sort. Returns up to 100 rows per page.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: Database id (32-char UUID with or without dashes)

parameters.name: start_cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

steps.description: POST — returns { results: [page], has_more, next_cursor }. The v1 runner sends an empty body (default 100 rows); add page_size / start_cursor via a custom api_call task if you need pagination.
GET — page object with property values but NOT block children

get_page_content.description: Fetch the block children of a page (paragraph, heading, list, toggle, etc.).

steps.description: GET — returns { results: [block], has_more, next_cursor }. Recurse into blocks with has_children=true.

create_page.description: Create a new page in a parent database with property values.

parameters.name: title_property
parameters.description: Name of the title property on that database (often 'Name')

parameters.name: title_value
parameters.description: Title text for the new page

steps.description: POST — creates an empty page with only the title filled. Use update_page_properties to set additional properties.

update_page_properties.description: Update one or more properties on an existing page.

parameters.name: properties_json
parameters.description: JSON-encoded properties object per Notion property-values schema

steps.description: PATCH — callers must pre-encode the properties shape since each property type differs

known_issues: Integrations only see databases/pages that were explicitly shared with them — silent 404s usually mean 'not shared', not 'does not exist'.
Notion-Version header is required on every request. Omitting it returns a 400 with a confusing 'invalid_request' message.
Rollup and formula properties are computed — you can read them but cannot write to them. update_page_properties will fail quietly on these.
Rich text content is deeply nested (blocks → rich_text[] → plain_text). Missions extracting page content should concat plain_text across all blocks.

fallback_hints.query_database: If you get 'object_not_found', the integration lacks access. Open the database in Notion → ... menu → Add connections → select the integration.
fallback_hints.create_page: If the title property name doesn't exist, you'll get 'validation_error'. Query the database's schema via /databases/${database_id} first and read the property whose type is 'title'.
